title: HtmlStrong
responsibility: Renders the native strong element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlStrong.attributes
inputs.description: Native strong attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlStrong.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native strong element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlStrong
outputs.description: The actual native strong element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
